comparison.objective: Pack a grocery tote with eggs above cans; candidate commissions an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Order-aware packing and gentle placement versus small-tool engagement, fine rotary adjustment, counterholding, and impact-response testing.
comparison.success_condition: Eggs remain above cans in the tote versus repeated non-bottoming carriage stops with no drift or damage. Detailed packing/damage thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Packing hierarchy and fragile-object handling are unrelated to mechanical tuning and locking.
